name: Kabardino-Balkaria (Kabardino-Balkar SSR, 1990–1994)
description: A red field with a blue vertical stripe at the hoist, a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a yellow-bordered red star in the upper hoist, and the inscription 'Кабардино-Балкарская ССР' in Russian, Kabardian and Balkar in yellow.
history: The RSFSR-pattern flag of the Kabardino-Balkar ASSR with the three-language inscription changed after the sovereignty declaration of January 1991. It was replaced on 21 July 1994 by the blue, white and green flag with Mount Elbrus.

features.role: inscription 'Кабардино-Балкарская ССР' in Russian, Kabardian and Balkar
